verdict.rationale: Sentry ships an official, well-documented sentry-cli covering installation, login, releases, debug files, source maps, send-event, log streaming, crons, snapshots and code mappings. The docs also describe an interactive developer CLI with issue management, AI-powered analysis and API access 'for humans and agents', and pair the CLI with the MCP server for use inside agent conversations. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of agent-driven CLI use, and in-depth docs for the AI-powered analysis features of the interactive CLI.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can use an official CLI

citations.quote: the interactive developer CLI with issue management, AI-powered analysis, and API access for humans and agents
Use Sentry without leaving your agent conversations by setting up the Sentry MCP server and Sentry CLI.
The sentry-cli tool can be used to view and stream logs from your Sentry projects.
It allows you to create, edit and delete releases as well as upload release artifacts for them.
We provide executables for Linux, OS X and Windows. It’s a single file download
